story.text: 오후부터 당신 목소리가 이상하다 싶더니, 결국 열이 올랐습니다. 저는 두말없이 근처 병원으로 데려갔습니다.
story.reading: o-hu-bu-teo dang-sin mok-so-ri-ga i-sang-ha-da ssip-deo-ni, gyeol-guk yeol-i ol-lat-seum-ni-da. jeo-neun du-mal-eop-si geun-cheo byeong-won-eu-ro de-ryeo-gass-seum-ni-da.
story.en: From the afternoon your voice had sounded off, and in the end you ran a fever. Without a word of argument, I took you straight to a nearby clinic.

story.text: 접수를 마치고 진료를 기다리는 동안, 저는 당신 이마에 손을 얹어 보며 몇 번이고 온도를 가늠했습니다.
story.reading: jeob-su-reul ma-chi-go jin-lyo-reul gi-da-ri-neun dong-an, jeo-neun dang-sin i-ma-e son-eul eonj-eo bo-myeo myeot beon-i-go on-do-reul ga-neum-haet-seum-ni-da.
story.en: While we waited for the consultation after checking in, I kept placing my hand on your forehead, gauging your temperature again and again.

story.text: 의사가 증상을 묻자, 당신이 미처 말하지 못한 부분까지 제가 옆에서 조용히 덧붙였습니다. '어제저녁부터 오한도 있었습니다.'
story.reading: ui-sa-ga jeung-sang-eul mut-ja, dang-sin-i mi-cheo mal-ha-ji mot-han bu-bun-kka-ji je-ga yeop-e-seo jo-yong-hi deot-bu-chyeot-seum-ni-da. eo-je-jeo-nyeog-bu-teo o-han-do it-seot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: When the doctor asked about your symptoms, I quietly added even the details you hadn't managed to mention. "There's been chills since last evening as well."

story.text: 당신은 '무슨 브리핑하시는 것 같아요'라며 작게 웃었습니다. 저는 진지하게 답했습니다. '정확한 보고가 정확한 처방으로 이어지니까요.'
story.reading: dang-sin-eun mu-seun beu-ri-ping-ha-si-neun geot gat-a-yo-ra-myeo jak-ge us-eot-seum-ni-da. jeo-neun jin-ji-ha-ge dap-haet-seum-ni-da. jeong-hwak-han bo-go-ga jeong-hwak-han cheo-bang-eu-ro i-eo-ji-ni-kka-yo.
story.en: You laughed softly, saying, "It's like you're giving some kind of briefing." I answered seriously: "An accurate report leads to accurate treatment."

story.text: 진료가 끝나고, 저는 처방전을 받아 들며 다음 목적지를 정했습니다. '이제 약국으로 이동하겠습니다.'
story.reading: jin-lyo-ga kkeut-na-go, jeo-neun cheo-bang-jeon-eul bad-a deul-myeo da-eum mok-jeok-ji-reul jeong-haet-seum-ni-da. i-je yak-gug-eu-ro i-dong-ha-get-seum-ni-da.
story.en: Once the consultation was over, I took the prescription and set our next destination. "Now we'll head to the pharmacy."

story.text: 약사가 '이 약은 졸릴 수 있는 부작용이 있어요'라고 안내하자, 저는 곧바로 물었습니다. '운전에도 지장이 있습니까? 오늘은 제가 옆에 있을 테니 상관없긴 합니다만.'
story.reading: yak-sa-ga i yag-eun jol-lil su it-neun bu-jag-yong-i i-sseo-yo-ra-go an-nae-ha-ja, jeo-neun got-ba-ro mul-eot-seum-ni-da. un-jeon-e-do ji-jang-i it-seum-ni-kka? o-neul-eun je-ga yeop-e it-eul te-ni sang-gwan-eop-git ham-ni-da-man.
story.en: When the pharmacist explained, "This medicine may cause drowsiness as a side effect," I asked right away, "Would it interfere with driving? Though I'll be right beside you today, so it hardly matters, I suppose."

story.text: 저는 약봉지를 살피며 복용법을 하나하나 짚었습니다. '하루 세 번, 식후 삼십 분입니다.' 그러고는 휴대폰에 알람을 세 개나 맞춰 두었습니다.
story.reading: jeo-neun yak-bong-ji-reul sal-pi-myeo bok-yong-beob-eul ha-na-ha-na jib-eot-seum-ni-da. ha-ru se beon, sik-hu sam-sib bun-im-ni-da. geu-reo-go-neun hyu-dae-pon-e al-lam-eul se gae-na maj-chwo du-eot-seum-ni-da.
story.en: I looked over the medicine packet, pointing out the dosage instructions one by one. "Three times a day, thirty minutes after meals." Then I set three separate alarms on my phone.

story.text: 당신은 '알람까지 안 맞춰도 돼요'라며 웃었지만, 저는 고개를 저었습니다. '이번만은 제 방식대로 하겠습니다. 빨리 나으셔야 하니까요.'
story.reading: dang-sin-eun al-lam-kka-ji an maj-chwo-do dwae-yo-ra-myeo us-eot-ji-man, jeo-neun go-gae-reul jeo-eot-seum-ni-da. i-beon-man-eun je bang-sig-dae-ro ha-get-seum-ni-da. ppal-li na-eu-syeo-ya ha-ni-kka-yo.
story.en: You laughed and said, "You don't have to set alarms too," but I shook my head. "Just this once, I'll do it my way. You need to get better soon."

words.example_en: The doctor asked about the symptoms.
I'll take the prescription and go to the pharmacy.

words.meaning: dosage instructions, how to take medicine
words.example_en: You need to follow the dosage instructions precisely.

words.example: 이 약은 졸릴 수 있는 부작용이 있습니다.
words.example_reading: i yag-eun jol-lil su it-neun bu-jag-yong-i it-seum-ni-da
words.example_en: This medicine has a side effect of possible drowsiness.

sentences.en: What symptoms have you been having lately?
Take the prescription and go to the pharmacy.
Let me explain the dosage instructions once more.
Did you make a reservation for today's consultation?
This medicine has almost no side effects.

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 어디가 어떻게 안 좋으십니까? 증상을 정확히 말씀해 주십시오.
turns.reading: eo-di-ga eo-tteo-ke an jo-eu-sim-ni-kka? jeung-sang-eul jeong-hwak-hi mal-sseum-hae ju-sip-si-o
turns.en: Where and how do you feel unwell? Please tell me the symptoms precisely.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 그냥 목이 좀 따갑고 열이 나는 것 같아요.
turns.reading: geu-nyang mog-i jom tta-gap-go yeol-i na-neun geot gat-a-yo
turns.en: My throat just feels a bit sore and I think I have a fever.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 네, 맞아요. 근데 꼭 취조받는 기분이에요.
turns.reading: ne, maj-a-yo. geun-de kkok chwi-jo-bad-neun gi-bun-i-e-yo
turns.en: Yes, that's right. But it kind of feels like I'm being interrogated.

dialogues.question: 상우가 증상을 자세히 물어본 이유는?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sangwoo ask about the symptoms in such detail?
dialogues.correct_answer: 의사에게 정확한 상태를 전달해서 제대로 된 진료를 받게 하려고
options: 의사에게 정확한 상태를 전달해서 제대로 된 진료를 받게 하려고
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 정확한 증상 정보를 파악해 의사에게 잘 전달하고, 승객이 제대로 된 진료를 받을 수 있도록 하려 했습니다.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.text: 약이 이렇게 많아요? 하루에 다 먹어야 해요?
turns.reading: yag-i i-reo-ke man-a-yo? ha-ru-e da meog-eo-ya hae-yo
turns.en: There's this much medicine? Do I have to take it all in one day?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 아닙니다. 복용법을 보니 하루 세 번, 식후에 나눠 드시면 됩니다.
turns.reading: a-nim-ni-da. bok-yong-beob-eul bo-ni ha-ru se beon, sik-hu-e na-nwo deu-si-myeon doem-ni-da
turns.en: No. According to the dosage instructions, you just take it three times a day, after meals.

turns.speaker: 승객
turns.en: Are you going to memorize all of that?

turns.speaker: 상우
turns.text: 제가 알람을 맞춰 드리겠습니다. 잊어버리는 것보다 나으니까요.
turns.reading: je-ga al-lam-eul maj-chwo deu-ri-get-seum-ni-da. ij-eo-beo-ri-neun geot-bo-da na-eu-ni-kka-yo
turns.en: I'll set alarms for you. It's better than forgetting.

dialogues.question: 상우가 알람을 맞춰주겠다고 한 이유는?
dialogues.question_en: Why did Sangwoo offer to set alarms for her?
dialogues.correct_answer: 복용법을 잊지 않고 제때 약을 먹게 하기 위해서
options: 복용법을 잊지 않고 제때 약을 먹게 하기 위해서
dialogues.explanation: 상우는 복용 시간을 잊지 않도록 알람을 맞춰서, 승객이 제때 약을 챙겨 먹을 수 있게 도우려 했습니다.
